name: fess-brand
description: FESS / Fidelity Services Group visual language, extracted from the FESS mobile app so the POS module, its phone preview and the admin panel look like FESS. Values marked "derived" are POS additions for accessibility (WCAG AA text contrast); everything else is copied from the FESS app.

source.app: ess-flutter (FESS mobile app, FlutterFlow) — read-only reference

primary.note: Fidelity green: app bar, primary buttons, splash, logo

goldText.note: gold for text on white (≈4.5:1); FESS gold on white is ≈2.4:1

goldTextStrong.note: gold text on a gold tint (status chips, D-97): ≈5.4:1 on component.chip's tint

body.note: most-used literal text colour in FESS

muted.note: textFieldIcon: chevrons, input icons (not for body text: ≈2.5:1)

successText.note: success text on a success tint (chips, D-97): the brand green, ≈5.4:1; FESS's #249689 is ≈3.6:1 on white

warningText.note: warning text on a warning tint (≈6:1); FESS's #F9CF58 is a fill, never text

infoText.note: info text on an info tint (≈5.6:1); FESS's #2799FF is ≈3:1 on white

font.source: Google Fonts (SIL Open Font License); FESS loads it with google_fonts (1,482 uses)
font.note: FESS's custom TTFs (Fesslogo*, Icomoon, …) are icon fonts, not text faces

page.note: D-97: white pages everywhere; content lines up with the header's back button, as on the FESS screens

back.note: custom_app_bar_widget: a 1 px white ring with a white arrow (FontAwesome arrowLeft, 12), not a filled circle

secondary.note: FESS uses white on gold; POS prefers green primary + outlined green secondary for contrast

outline.note: POS secondary buttons (D-97), as FESS's Reset Passcode (pin_page): white, a 2 px gold outline, dark semibold text

danger.note: FESS's Delete Account (settings_page); white on it is ≈5.3:1

card.note: D-97: a box only where one is needed, white with a light border and no shadow (FESS Settings). shadow is kept for consumers that haven't moved yet

input.note: FESS Account Recovery (recover_account2): white, a 2 px #E0E3E7 border, a grey 16 px leading icon

chip.note: readable status chips (D-97): a light tint of the status colour behind its derived *Text colour, never white on gold

stat.note: the home stats as one flat strip between hairlines (D-97)

bottomNav.note: inactive (#D8D8D8) is FESS's icon grey, too faint for a label (≈1.4:1); POS draws inactive items in inactiveItem. No highlight pill

material.note: FESS runs Material 2. The POS module brings its own scoped theme (findings/03 §3) built from these tokens.

assets.logo: Fidelity Services Group wordmark, green and gold (FESS assets/images/Fidelity-logo.png)
assets.appIcon: white F mark on green (FESS assets/images/FESSAppIcon_(2).png)
